title: Syncing Code: push, clone, pull & fetch
introduction: Today you master the four pillars of Git synchronization: `push` (upload local work), `clone` (download an entire repository), `fetch` (check for updates safely), and `pull` (download and merge remote changes into your code).
why_it_matters: Syncing code is what makes Git a team tool. Knowing exactly what happens during a `pull` vs a `fetch` prevents unexpected merge conflicts and accidental overwritten code.
practical_activity_preview: Push your local commits to GitHub, make an edit online, and pull it back to your computer.
